scope: Owned additions and paired C30/F22 continuation; earlier studies preserved.

shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **普遍唯一性的直接检验 / Direct uniqueness test, 8 October 2026.** [新研究](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-STRUCTURE-INTEGRATION.md)新增 **32项 Lean 定理／74项含继承审计**：固定问题下准确、约简的表述具有双向唯一对应；同一棋盘目标的整体覆盖与局部放置精确对应，颜色结构可解释去角棋盘的不可能性，却不足以确定全部铺法。 / This establishes relative uniqueness of answer distinctions, not unique generative ontology. A compact same-content global rival survives; mathematical explanation is distinguished from the history of proof acquisition. Audits: 62 empty and 12 using only standard `propext`. Next test independently specified composition relations, preserving prior calibration results and the separate normative route.

**相对唯一性与数学解释 / Relative uniqueness and mathematical explanation, 8 October 2026.** [直接检验](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#17-一个已经证明的相对唯一性)已有32项新定理：准确最小表述在固定问题下双向唯一对应，棋盘整体覆盖与逐步历史精确相连；不由此选出时间式生成解释的优先性。 / The structural rival retains the same target. Standard `propext` dependencies are disclosed separately from empty audits. Next compare preservation of composition, not just agreement of answers.

**Direct explanatory-uniqueness test, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s authorization](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#普遍唯一性的直接检验--direct-test-of-universal-uniqueness) is preserved with the assistant’s proposed route separately marked. [Source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-STRUCTURE-INTEGRATION.md#7-primary-sources-and-inherited-work) reads selected Adlam text, the Naproche checkerboard paper and AFP entry metadata; rejected full-text requests for philosophical comparisons retain abstract-only scope. All external materials are link-only, with no imported bytes or novelty claim for the checkerboard proof.

**Fixed answers → relative uniqueness; matched structure → limits of priority, 8 October 2026.** [The direct explanatory test](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-STRUCTURE-INTEGRATION.md) checks 32 new theorems / 74 audits (62 empty, 12 standard `propext` only). Exact reduced presentations induce a uniquely matched answer structure on used codes, conditional on the fixed question family and minimality. Compact global tiling and local placement have the same coverage content; a structural balance obstruction need not retain the entire process. This preserves shared relational-content support while blocking an unsupported inference to unique temporal or ontological priority. The next bridge asks which independently required composition/substitution relations must also be preserved. No universal normative warrant is supplied; prior formation/calibration results remain in scope.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 目标相关的关系内容贯通可用变化、证据保留、实际正反证据取得、校准、变化后失效及有支持的再用；历史真实与当前适用可分离。
C30.claim_en: Target-relevant relations connect available variation, retention, acquired positive/negative evidence, calibration, invalidation and supported reuse; historical truth can outlast current applicability.
C30.scope_zh: 前两轮17项及45项定理保留；本轮40项新定理／128项含继承审计。可靠参考、共同通道、变化覆盖及支持明示；完整失败历史限制标签保证，整体约束对手与普遍优先性问题保留。下一步解释选择性校准与变化检测。
C30.scope_en: Earlier 17- and 45-theorem studies retained; new 40-theorem study / 128 audits including imports. Reference reliability, shared channel, change coverage and support are explicit. Realized failure histories limit label-based guarantees; global rivals and universal priority remain open. Next explain selective recalibration and change monitoring.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、证据取得与有效再用
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, evidence acquisition and valid reuse
F22.claim_zh: 在原有恢复、变化及保留结果上，直接复用知识解码定理，检查正反证据取得、任意有限历史有效性、失效与再校准、资源守恒及同起点失误过程。
F22.claim_en: Extends recovery, variation and retention by directly reusing the knowledge decoder: checks acquired evidence, validity across arbitrary finite lawful histories, invalidation/recalibration, resource accounting and faulty histories from valid starts.
F22.scope_zh: 本轮40项新定理＋88项继承审计＝128项空公理依赖审计；单次四事件、保留参考两事件和完整修正历史分别明示。无噪声局部规律不等于零前提，历史存在不等于控制保证，标签一致不等于正确。
F22.scope_en: 40 new theorems + 88 inherited audits = 128 empty dependency audits. Four-event acquisition, two-event retained-reference reuse and the full correction history have distinct contracts. Noiseless local laws are premises; path existence is not control, and matching labels do not ensure correctness.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 目标相关的关系内容贯通变化、证据取得及再用；固定问题下准确最小表述双向唯一对应，但同内容整体覆盖与数学结构说明仍保留，不能仅由可恢复性选定解释优先。
C30.claim_en: Target-relevant relations connect variation, evidence acquisition and reuse. Exact reduced presentations uniquely match for fixed questions, while same-content global coverage and structural explanations remain viable; recoverability alone does not select explanatory priority.
C30.scope_zh: 此前17、45、40项定理各保留范围；本轮32项新定理／74项审计（62空依赖、12仅标准propext）。最小性与问题范围明示；棋盘颜色障碍不决定全部覆盖。下一步检验组合关系的保留，普遍唯一性和规范根据仍开放。
C30.scope_en: Prior 17-, 45- and 40-theorem studies retain scope; new 32-theorem study / 74 audits (62 empty, 12 standard propext only). Minimality and questions are explicit; color obstruction does not determine all coverage. Next test preserved composition; universal uniqueness and normative warrant remain open.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、证据再用与相对唯一性
F22.title_en: Relation recovery, evidence reuse and relative uniqueness
F22.claim_zh: 继承必要内容、变化与校准证明；新增准确约简表述的唯一对应、整体覆盖与局部放置等价、去角棋盘结构障碍和问题范围反例。
F22.claim_en: Retains content, variation and calibration proofs; adds unique matching of exact reduced presentations, global/local coverage equivalence, the mutilated-board obstruction and query-scope counterexamples.
F22.scope_zh: 最新17项结构＋15项唯一性定理，连同42项继承审计共74项；核心相对唯一性为空依赖，12项结构相关声明使用标准propext，无自定公理。表述对应不等于生成操作同构，形式验证不证明唯一基础。
F22.scope_en: Latest 17 structural + 15 uniqueness theorems, with 42 inherited audits for 74 total. Core relative uniqueness has empty dependencies; 12 structural declarations use standard propext, with no custom axioms. Presentation matching is not generative-operation isomorphism or unique grounding.
